meta.title: Content Tags
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Content Tags".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Content Tags', 'joomlaguide-content-tags', '

Tags group content across categories: an article is in one category, but it can have as many tags as apply to it.

In this tour you create the tags Cargo and Insurance, tag three articles, show the tagged articles with a menu item, and filter the list of articles by tag.

This tour follows the tutorial 11.1 Content Tags of the Joomla User Guide.
